claims.statement: Historical community and marketplace evidence supports a flat-top MNKE IMR 18650 format, but no exact wrapper color, observed dimensions, or underlying cell identity was verified for this catalog revision.
Steam Engine preserves MNKE IMR 18650 1500mAh 20C as a 1500mAh preset with a 20C runtime rating.

The MNKE IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for MNKE IMR 18650 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
